device_types.name: Electric parallel gripper
device_types.description: Two-jaw gripper with jaws moving linearly in parallel, driven by a servo or stepper motor with position and force control.

properties.name: gripping_force
properties.description: Rated gripping force (sum over jaws unless stated)

telemetry.name: object_detected
telemetry.description: Bool: part gripped within expected jaw window

failure_modes: dropped part on power loss without self-locking

device_types.name: Pneumatic parallel gripper
device_types.description: Two- or three-jaw gripper actuated by a pneumatic piston via wedge-hook or rack; force set by supply pressure.

properties.name: gripping_force
properties.description: Rated gripping force (sum over jaws unless stated)

properties.name: grip_retention_spring
properties.description: Spring keeps force on air loss

maintenance.action: replace seal kit per vendor rating

device_types.name: Angular gripper
device_types.description: Jaws pivot about a fixed axis (typically up to 180 deg opening), clearing the part so the robot can approach from above.

device_types.name: Three-finger adaptive gripper
device_types.description: Underactuated gripper with three articulated fingers that conform to part shape; modes for pinch, wide and encompassing grasps.

device_types.name: Dexterous multi-finger hand
device_types.description: Anthropomorphic hand with many actively driven DOF (typically 12-24) and tactile or joint torque sensing for in-hand manipulation.

device_types.name: Underactuated hand
device_types.description: Hand with fewer actuators than joints, using linkages, tendons or differentials so fingers wrap passively around objects.

device_types.name: Vacuum cup gripper
device_types.description: One or more elastomer suction cups evacuated by an ejector (Venturi) or pump; the standard tool for flat, sealed-surface parts.

maintenance.action: replace; typical life varies strongly with material and abrasion

failure_modes: vacuum leak on porous or uneven parts

device_types.name: Vacuum foam (area) gripper
device_types.description: Large-area gripper with a perforated plate and closed-cell foam seal, often with per-hole check valves, for boxes and mixed layers.

maintenance.action: replace when compressed set or cut

device_types.name: Bernoulli gripper
device_types.description: Contact-light gripper using a radial air jet to create a low-pressure region, used for wafers, solar cells and fragile thin parts.

device_types.name: Electro-permanent magnetic gripper
device_types.description: Permanent magnet whose field is switched on/off by a short current pulse; holds ferrous parts with zero power and fails safe on power loss.

properties.name: holding_force
properties.description: On thick mild steel; derate for thin, coated or rough parts

failure_modes: electromagnet type drops part on power loss

device_types.name: Needle gripper
device_types.description: Pneumatically extended angled needles that penetrate textiles, composites or foams to hold porous parts vacuum cannot.

device_types.name: Soft finger gripper
device_types.description: Elastomeric pneumatic fingers that bend under pressure/vacuum to grasp delicate, irregular items such as food.

device_types.name: Electroadhesive gripper
device_types.description: Pads with interdigitated electrodes at kV potentials that induce electrostatic adhesion to fabrics, films and flat parts.
failure_modes: slow release due to residual charge

device_types.name: Granular jamming gripper
device_types.description: Membrane filled with granular media that conforms to an object and stiffens when evacuated.

device_types.name: Sack and bag gripper
device_types.description: Vacuum or clamp-type gripper for flexible sacks (cement, feed, grain), often combined with bottom forks for heavy bags.

device_types.name: Fork/tine end effector
device_types.description: Tines or forks to lift pallets, slip sheets or layers from below, used on palletizers and forklift-type robots.

device_types.name: Manual tool changer
device_types.description: Quick-change interface locked by hand (lever or bolt) with optional pass-through for air and electrical signals.

device_types.name: Automatic tool changer
device_types.description: Master/tool plate pair locked pneumatically or electrically by the robot, with signal, power, air and fieldbus modules; fail-safe locking keeps tool on air loss.

maintenance.action: inspect pins for wear and arcing

failure_modes: tool dropped due to incomplete lock

device_types.name: Compliance / float unit
device_types.description: Passive or active compliance element (remote center compliance, XY float, axial float) that absorbs misalignment during insertion or contact tasks.

device_types.name: Collision sensor / breakaway unit
device_types.description: Spring-loaded or pneumatic overload clutch between flange and tool that deflects and opens a switch on collision, stopping the robot.

device_types.name: Screwdriver / nutrunner
device_types.description: Torque-controlled electric spindle with transducer for automated screw driving and bolting, often with screw feeding.

device_types.name: MIG/MAG welding torch
device_types.description: Gas metal arc welding torch fed with wire and shielding gas, mounted with an anti-collision mount and powered by an arc welding source.

device_types.name: TIG welding torch
device_types.description: Gas tungsten arc torch with non-consumable electrode, often with cold-wire feed, for precise welds.

device_types.name: Resistance spot welding gun
device_types.description: C- or X-type gun clamping sheets between electrodes with servo or pneumatic force and passing high current through them.

maintenance.action: tip dress / replace per weld count

device_types.name: Laser welding/cutting head
device_types.description: Fiber-delivered processing head with focusing optics, protective window, height sensing and optional scanner for laser welding or cutting.

device_types.name: Plasma cutting torch
device_types.description: Constricted-arc torch cutting conductive metals, fed by a plasma power source and gas console; with collision mount.

maintenance.action: replace per arc-on hours / pierce count

device_types.name: Spray paint gun / rotary atomizer
device_types.description: Air, airless, electrostatic or rotary bell atomizer for painting and coating; often in explosive atmospheres requiring ATEX-rated design.

device_types.name: Adhesive/sealant dispenser
device_types.description: Volumetric or time-pressure dispensing valve applying glue, sealant or beads, with flow and bead monitoring.

device_types.name: Polishing/sanding spindle
device_types.description: Electric or pneumatic random-orbit or rotary spindle, typically with active force-controlled flange and automatic abrasive change.

device_types.name: Deburring tool
device_types.description: Radially or axially compliant spindle with burr or blade for edge deburring on robots tolerant to path deviation.

device_types.name: Drilling/milling spindle
device_types.description: High-speed motor spindle with tool holder (ER collet, HSK, ISO taper) for robotic drilling, trimming and light machining.

device_types.name: Ultrasonic cutter
device_types.description: Blade excited at ultrasonic frequency (typically 20-40 kHz) by a transducer/booster stack for cutting food, rubber, composites and films.

device_types.name: Camera-on-tool module
device_types.description: Wrist- or tool-mounted vision module (2D or 3D) used for eye-in-hand calibration, picking and inspection; the sensor itself is a sensor.camera.* type.

maintenance.action: re-calibrate after collision or tool change

device_types.name: Pipette/syringe end effector
device_types.description: Liquid-handling tool with air-displacement or positive-displacement channels, tip pick/eject and liquid-level detection for lab automation.

device_types.name: Wristed surgical instrument
device_types.description: Cable-driven articulated instrument (graspers, needle drivers, scissors, energy) for robotically assisted surgery; life-limited and sterilized between uses.

maintenance.action: retire at labeled use count; reprocess per IFU

device_types.name: Agricultural harvesting end effector
device_types.description: Fruit- or vegetable-specific tool (suction tube, soft fingers, cutter or rotating detacher) combined with a camera for selective harvesting.

device_types.name: Cleaning brush head
device_types.description: Rotating disc, roller or side brush for floor, panel or hull cleaning robots, driven by its own motor.

maintenance.action: typical replacement for consumer robots; inspect bristles

device_types.name: Mop module
device_types.description: Wet cleaning module with pad, rotating mops or roller and water tank/pump, sometimes liftable over carpet.

device_types.name: UV-C disinfection lamp array
device_types.description: Array of low-pressure mercury or UV-C LED sources (around 254 nm or 265-280 nm) on disinfection robots; requires interlocks against human exposure.

maintenance.action: replace at rated life (UV output decays)

failure_modes: UV exposure of humans if interlock fails

device_types.name: Electric vacuum gripper (onboard pump)
device_types.description: Vacuum gripper with integrated electric pump, needing no compressed air; common on cobots and mobile manipulators.

device_types.name: Dual / multi-tool gripper head
device_types.description: Head combining two or more grippers (e.g. load and unload jaws, or gripper plus vacuum) to reduce cycle time.

device_types.name: Tactile sensing fingertip
device_types.description: Replaceable fingertip with tactile array (resistive, capacitive, optical gel) providing contact pressure and slip detection.

device_types.name: Tote/bin handling gripper
device_types.description: Hook, clamp or telescoping arm attachment for picking totes and bins in warehouse robots.

device_types.name: Wheeled chassis
device_types.description: Structural base of a wheeled mobile robot carrying drive units, battery and payload; differential, Ackermann, skid-steer or omnidirectional.

device_types.name: Tracked chassis
device_types.description: Crawler base with rubber or steel tracks, sprockets and road wheels for rough terrain, stairs or agriculture.

maintenance.action: check tension, replace when lugs worn

device_types.name: Rocker-bogie suspension
device_types.description: Passive linkage suspension (as on planetary rovers) keeping all six wheels in contact over obstacles via a differential.

device_types.name: Independent wheel suspension
device_types.description: Spring-damper suspension per wheel (swing arm, double wishbone) to keep drive wheel traction on uneven floors.
failure_modes: loss of traction from spring fatigue

device_types.name: Arm link segment
device_types.description: Rigid structural member between joints of a manipulator or leg, defining kinematic lengths and stiffness.

maintenance.action: visual inspection for cracks or impact damage

device_types.name: Revolute joint
device_types.description: Rotational joint assembly (housing, bearings, seal, hard stops) about one axis, actuated by an actuator.* module.

device_types.name: Prismatic joint
device_types.description: Linear joint with guide rails/carriages, providing translation along one axis (e.g. gantry or SCARA Z axis).

device_types.name: Spherical joint
device_types.description: Ball-and-socket or rod-end joint allowing three rotational DOF; used in parallel kinematics (delta, hexapod) and passive linkages.

device_types.name: Bearing housing assembly
device_types.description: Housing that locates rolling bearings (deep-groove, angular-contact, crossed-roller) in a structure; the bearing as drivetrain element is a transmission.* type.

maintenance.action: monitor vibration and temperature; regrease if serviceable

device_types.name: Mechanical spring
device_types.description: Compression, extension, torsion or constant-force spring used for return, gravity compensation or preload.

device_types.name: Gas spring / strut
device_types.description: Sealed cylinder of pressurized nitrogen giving near-constant force for lids, gravity compensation or counterbalance.
failure_modes: pressure loss allowing a lid or arm to drop

device_types.name: Damper / shock absorber
device_types.description: Hydraulic, elastomer or friction damper dissipating energy at end stops, suspensions or compliance units.

device_types.name: Counterbalance system
device_types.description: Spring, gas or counterweight system compensating gravity on heavy robot axes (e.g. axis 2 of large manipulators).

maintenance.action: inspect for leaks and wear per robot manual

failure_modes: balancer failure causing axis to drop under brake load

device_types.name: Cable carrier (drag chain)
device_types.description: Chain of links guiding moving cables and hoses on linear axes, with a defined bending radius.

maintenance.action: inspect for broken links and cable wear

device_types.name: Robot dress pack
device_types.description: Cable and hose package routed along a manipulator with retraction and protective hoses to the tool.

device_types.name: Protective cover / skin
device_types.description: Covers, jackets or padded skins protecting a robot from dust, coolant or paint, or padding to reduce contact pressure on humans.

device_types.name: IP-rated enclosure
device_types.description: Housing for electronics with defined ingress protection, gaskets and cable glands.

device_types.name: Seal / gasket
device_types.description: Static or dynamic seal (O-ring, lip seal, labyrinth) that maintains ingress protection or retains lubricant at joints.

maintenance.action: replace on leakage or at service intervals

device_types.name: Frame / extrusion structure
device_types.description: T-slot aluminum profile or welded frame forming cells, gantries, robot carts or mounts.

device_types.name: Foot / sole (legged)
device_types.description: Contact element at the end of a leg: rubber hemisphere, flat sole or instrumented foot with contact sensing.

device_types.name: Propeller guard
device_types.description: Ring or cage around rotors protecting people and objects from propeller strikes and the prop from damage.

device_types.name: Multirotor airframe
device_types.description: Frame (arms, body plates, landing gear) of quad-, hexa- or octocopters.
failure_modes: vibration from loose parts degrading IMU

device_types.name: Fixed-wing airframe
device_types.description: Wing, fuselage and tail structure of fixed-wing or VTOL hybrid UAVs including control surfaces.

device_types.name: Marine hull
device_types.description: Displacement or planing hull, or pressure housing for surface vessels, AUVs and ROVs.

maintenance.action: inspect and grease before each dive

device_types.name: Ballast / buoyancy system
device_types.description: Fixed or variable ballast (tanks, pumps, oil bladders, drop weights) controlling buoyancy and trim of underwater vehicles.

device_types.name: Telescopic mast
device_types.description: Extendable mast raising sensors, cameras or antennas on mobile robots and vehicles.

device_types.name: Caster wheel
device_types.description: Passive swivel or fixed caster supporting a mobile base.

device_types.name: Teach pendant
device_types.description: Handheld programming/operating unit with display, emergency stop and three-position enabling switch, cabled or wireless to the robot controller.

maintenance.action: test per risk assessment and manufacturer

failure_modes: enabling switch stuck in middle position
wireless link loss (must lead to stop)

device_types.name: Touch display
device_types.description: Capacitive or resistive touchscreen panel on robots for status and interaction.

device_types.name: Status / stack light
device_types.description: Signal tower with coloured segments and optional buzzer indicating machine state; colour meanings per IEC 60204-1 and IEC 60073.
failure_modes: segment LED failure masking a state

device_types.name: LED ring / status bar
device_types.description: Addressable LED ring or light bar on cobots and AMRs communicating mode, intent or direction.

device_types.name: Speaker / sounder
device_types.description: Loudspeaker or buzzer for voice, alerts or warning sounds.

device_types.name: Microphone (HMI)
device_types.description: Microphone used for voice interaction; arrays for localization are sensor.microphone_array.

device_types.name: Joystick
device_types.description: Analog or digital multi-axis joystick for jogging or driving robots and vehicles; industrial ones may include deadman or e-stop.

device_types.name: Gamepad
device_types.description: Consumer game controller used for teleoperation and development; not a safety device.

device_types.name: RC transmitter
device_types.description: Hobby/industrial radio control transmitter for drones, ground vehicles and boats with failsafe on signal loss.

device_types.name: Haptic master device
device_types.description: Grounded multi-DOF input device with force feedback used to teleoperate a follower robot.

device_types.name: VR/AR headset
device_types.description: Head-mounted display for immersive teleoperation, training or AR overlays of robot intent.

device_types.name: Voice assistant module
device_types.description: Embedded module with wake-word detection, mic front-end and optional on-device speech recognition.

device_types.name: Intent projector
device_types.description: Projector or laser line emitter showing an AMR's path, stop zone or warning onto the floor.

device_types.name: Buttons / keypad
device_types.description: Pushbuttons, selector switches or membrane keypads for start, stop, reset and mode selection.

device_types.name: Industrial HMI panel
device_types.description: Panel PC or operator terminal with HMI runtime, connecting via OPC UA, fieldbus or web to the controller.

device_types.name: Mobile app device (tablet)
device_types.description: Tablet or phone running an app for robot setup, fleet supervision or teleoperation; not a safety device.

device_types.name: Wearable alert device
device_types.description: Wrist or badge device that vibrates or beeps to warn workers of approaching robots or vehicles, often UWB-based.

device_types.name: Foot switch / pedal
device_types.description: Foot-operated switch for start, clamp or enable functions (e.g. surgical consoles, workstations).

device_types.name: Emergency stop button
device_types.description: Red mushroom pushbutton on yellow background with direct opening action and latching; initiates stop category 0 or 1 per ISO 13850.

maintenance.action: operate and verify stop; interval per risk assessment and manufacturer

device_types.name: Wireless emergency stop
device_types.description: Handheld or fixed e-stop transmitting a periodic safe telegram; the receiver opens safety outputs on button press or loss of communication.

maintenance.action: press and verify stop; test link-loss behaviour

device_types.name: Three-position enabling switch
device_types.description: Hand-held enabling device permitting motion only in the middle position; release or full press (panic) stops motion.

maintenance.action: verify release and full-press both stop motion

failure_modes: switch taped or wedged in middle position

device_types.name: Safety relay
device_types.description: Dedicated monitoring relay with force-guided contacts and self-monitoring for e-stop, gates or light curtains; outputs open on fault.
failure_modes: output contact welding (detected by feedback loop)
automatic reset used where manual reset required

device_types.name: Safety controller / safety PLC
device_types.description: Programmable or configurable safety logic with dual-channel I/O and diagnostics; the compute hardware may also be catalogued as compute.safety_plc.

maintenance.action: revalidate after program change; keep program CRC under change control

failure_modes: output short not detected on single channel

device_types.name: Safety light curtain
device_types.description: Active opto-electronic protective device (AOPD) with OSSD outputs detecting intrusion into a plane; Type 2 or Type 4 per IEC 61496.

properties.name: resolution
properties.description: 14 mm finger, 30 mm hand, larger for body

maintenance.action: daily/shift test with specified test rod

device_types.name: Safety laser scanner system
device_types.description: Configured protective/warning field system based on an AOPDDR; the sensor is sensor.lidar.safety_scanner, this type covers the field set configuration and switching.

maintenance.action: test with test body after configuration change

failure_modes: wrong field set selected for speed

device_types.name: Pressure-sensitive safety mat
device_types.description: Floor mat whose contacts close under foot pressure, signalling presence in a hazardous zone.

device_types.name: Pressure-sensitive safety edge
device_types.description: Profile with internal contact chamber or optical sensing that trips on compression; used on doors, gates and moving parts.

device_types.name: Safety bumper (mobile)
device_types.description: Pressure-sensitive bumper or edge on mobile robots that stops the drive on contact.

maintenance.action: press along length and verify stop

device_types.name: Door interlock switch
device_types.description: Interlocking device detecting guard position: tongue switch, hinge switch, coded magnetic or RFID sensor, with defined coding level against defeat.

maintenance.action: open guard and verify stop; check for defeat

device_types.name: Guard locking device
device_types.description: Interlock with solenoid lock keeping a guard closed until hazardous motion has stopped (power-to-unlock or power-to-lock).

maintenance.action: verify lock holds during motion and escape release works

device_types.name: Two-hand control device
device_types.description: Requires simultaneous (within 0.5 s) actuation of two controls to start and hold a hazardous function; Types I, II, IIIA-C.

maintenance.action: verify single-hand and non-synchronous actuation do not start

device_types.name: Safe torque off (STO) module
device_types.description: Drive safety function preventing torque-producing energy to the motor (IEC 61800-5-2 STO); often with SS1 and safe brake control.

maintenance.action: forced dynamization/test at the interval stated by the drive manufacturer

failure_modes: axis falls under gravity when STO active without brake

device_types.name: Safety-rated monitored stop function
device_types.description: Safety function that monitors standstill while drive power remains on, used for operator entry (ISO 10218 collaborative operation).

device_types.name: Speed and separation monitoring system
device_types.description: System combining human detection and robot speed limits to keep a protective separation distance, per ISO/TS 15066 collaborative operation.

maintenance.action: re-measure stopping times and verify after layout change

device_types.name: Power and force limiting skin/sensor
device_types.description: Tactile skin, capacitive proximity skin or joint torque sensing used to detect contact and limit transferred force/pressure in collaborative operation.

maintenance.action: measure with force/pressure gauge against biomechanical limits

device_types.name: Muting sensors
device_types.description: Pair or set of sensors that temporarily suspend a light curtain while material (not people) passes, with timing and sequence monitoring.

maintenance.action: verify a person cannot trigger muting

failure_modes: muting misuse allowing person to pass

device_types.name: Safety encoder (reference)
device_types.description: Safety-rated position/speed feedback for safe motion functions; device details live under sensor.encoder.*, this type captures the safety assessment.

maintenance.action: verify, since shaft slip is often an excluded fault requiring form-fit coupling

device_types.name: Perimeter fence / fixed guard
device_types.description: Fixed and movable guarding (mesh panels, posts, doors) around a robot cell, sized per safety distance standards.

maintenance.action: inspect for damage and removed fixings

device_types.name: Warning beacon / buzzer
device_types.description: Flashing or rotating beacon with sounder warning of robot motion or AGV approach.

device_types.name: Gas / fire detection interlock
device_types.description: Gas, smoke or flame detector wired into the safety chain to stop or isolate robots and charging, e.g. in battery rooms or paint booths.

device_types.name: Brake test function
device_types.description: Function or module that periodically tests holding brakes of gravity-loaded axes by applying torque against the closed brake.

maintenance.action: run at the interval required by the robot/drive manufacturer

device_types.name: Safe motion unit
device_types.description: Safety-rated robot controller option supervising safe zones, tool orientation, speed limits, standstill and brakes from redundant position data.

properties.name: supported_functions
properties.description: e.g. SLS, SLP, SOS, SBC, tool zone

maintenance.action: validate configuration after every change; keep checksum under control

device_types.name: Safety reset device
device_types.description: Manual reset pushbutton located outside the hazard zone with full view, required after a safeguard trip before restart.

device_types.name: Redundant safety contactors
device_types.description: Pair of contactors with mirror contacts in series, switched by a safety output to remove power; feedback detects welding.

device_types.name: Mode selector / key switch
device_types.description: Lockable operating-mode selector (auto, manual reduced speed, manual high speed) forming part of the safety function.

device_types.name: Safety I/O module
device_types.description: Remote dual-channel input/output module communicating over a safety protocol (FSoE, PROFIsafe, CIP Safety) with test pulses and diagnostics.

device_types.name: Trapped-key interlock
device_types.description: Mechanical key-transfer system ensuring isolation is applied before guard access.

device_types.name: Pneumatic safety exhaust valve
device_types.description: Redundant, monitored dump valve that safely exhausts pneumatic energy from grippers and actuators on a safety demand.
